messages:
morgan: quick sync — prepping v4 model switch. proposing a 'traffic-slice' feature flag scoped by region + tenant safelist. planning to start small tomorrow 09:00 PT. need quick +1s on initial %s and guardrails. anyone seeing major blockers?

kai: i'm +1. my suggestion: global 2% initial, but bias pilot to us-west at 5% so we can collect latency/costs faster. eu 1%, apac 0.5%. keep autoscale overrides disabled for the first hour. :+1:

lee: noted — we must confirm EU latency/residency impacts. last time v3 EU canary had ~400ms p50 uplift on seq+gen workloads. can we ensure per-route fallback to v3-stable if p95 spikes?

sophie: agree with lee. also propose adding an enterprise safelist so paying customers and internal apps stay on v3 until CS signs off. and set automated rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% or p95 latency +20% vs baseline.

morgan: good catches. kai — can you paste the flag snippet you'd upload to the orchestrator so infra knows the JSON shape?

kai: sure — draft below (will PR this to infra flags repo):

```json
{
  "flag": "traffic_slice_v4",
  "scopes": [
    {"region": "us-west", "percent": 5},
    {"region": "eu-central", "percent": 1},
    {"region": "apac-southeast", "percent": 0.5}
  ],
  "global_percent": 2,
  "safelist_tiers": ["enterprise", "internal"],
  "fallback_model": "v3-stable",
  "rollback_triggers": [
    {"metric": "errors", "threshold": 0.005},
    {"metric": "p95_latency_pct_change", "threshold": 0.20}
  ],
  "cooldown_minutes": 30
}
```

deploy-bot: created flag traffic_slice_v4 (id=fs_789abc), scheduled.enable=2025-03-12T16:00:00Z, created_by=kai

lee: i'm going to run synthetic traffic against EU endpoints this afternoon to re-check latency baseline and failure modes. tagging @oncall to make sure SRE watches the run.

alex: (eng-sre) on it — i'll kick off the canary harness at 50 RPS for 30m and post the p50/p95 + error graphs here. will also validate KV cache pressure.

sophie: :thumbsup: can we enforce a cooldown window of 30m between percent jumps and require manual ack from morgan for any jump >10%?

kai: added cooldown_minutes=30 in the flag above. will open PR to add enforcement in the rollout script and include manual-ack check for >10% increments.

morgan: perfect. tagging @oncall and eng-sre for visibility. after the synthetic run, please paste the graphs and we'll decide whether to proceed with the scheduled enable or postpone. i'll also add a note in the Console runbook under 'model rollouts -> v4' with the safelist and rollback policy.

deploy-bot: note — audit log entry created: feature_flag.fs_789abc.created by kai at 2025-03-11T18:12:07Z

lee: acknowledged. will share synthetic results by EOD.

morgan: thanks everyone. if no blockers by EOD i'll merge the flag PR and confirm scheduled enable.
